Adult visitors compare the subtle colored ceramic surfaces without touching protected architecture. Village daily life, no copied modern artwork. Original peaceful full-bleed vertical artwork, layered filled background. No text, letters, logos, copied artwork, or invented maps. Adults in opaque everyday clothes only if people appear.
